text: An object and a plan don't get 150 people off email and spreadsheets by themselves. This lesson plans the reports leadership needs, and the rollout that gets everyone there.
Three views are planned: claims by region, claims by status, and an aging view that surfaces anything sitting past its SLA window.
Training splits by role -- reps logging claims, managers reviewing them, and a short awareness session for Sales.
Before general rollout, Hannah Reyes and Tobias Lindgren will run real, live claims through the new system -- a UAT step that hasn't happened yet.
Next: the first real build -- creating the Warranty_Claim__c object and every field it needs.
